all_row_obligations.source_access: Resolve full original, register/intake, bibliography/source limits, all touching relations/pairs, group contexts/tensions/configurations and rejected induced candidates from the exact public packets. Digests without retrievable content are insufficient.
all_row_obligations.current_load: Actual current governor -> relevant existing reference -> this issue receiving decision. Documentary source mapping does not claim installed native operational-evidence or canonical-rotation behavior.
all_row_obligations.event_acceptance: Every selected event claim binds schema/definition/version/instance, observed meaning and uncertainty, population, original verdict, actual recipient rights and present predicate. Observation, attempt, performed action and accepted effect remain distinct.
all_row_obligations.change_radius: Preserve old facts and unaffected claims. Withhold only dependent changed uses until their mapping and entitled acceptance are re-established.
all_row_obligations.benefit_boundary: Diagnosis, prediction, simulation and selected comparison support only their actual quantities/populations. No general intervention benefit or external validity is established.
all_row_obligations.continuation: Closed issue certification -> document -> this complete target meaning -> full original corpus remains the continuing entry. A future actual custody transfer needs entitled full-content/action acceptance before predecessor retirement.
all_row_obligations.prepared_target_projection: All material corrected target meaning is reproduced; private canonical cell/admin provenance and recovery-observation payloads remain local. Their absence grants no execution or campaign qualification.
all_row_obligations.literal_preservation: Frozen research strings are retained. No source judgment, claim, relation direction or guard is silently repaired.

limits: All 4547 have a recorded mechanical target; no whole-target absence is inferred for the 18.

Historical target preparation and new issue documentary receiving remain separate from actual native/empirical qualification.
